mapper.insert: MERGE INTO FESTIVAL_AREA_CONFIG A USING DUAL ON (A.MAP_NAME = #{mapName}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.CONFIG_JSON = #{configJson}, A.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CONFIG_ID, MAP_NAME, CONFIG_JSON, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_AREA_CONFIG.NEXTVAL, #{mapName}, #{configJson}, SYSDATE)
